newsitem.title: BULGARIA: NO SHARES TRADE ON BULGARIA BOURSES FOR TENTH DAY.
newsitem.headline: NO SHARES TRADE ON BULGARIA BOURSES FOR TENTH DAY.

text.p: No corporate stocks traded on Bulgarian bourses for a tenth day in row and the RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Thursday's 41.28 points, brokers said.
No repo deals in treasury paper were struck either.
Thursday's repo turnover surged to an all-time high of 20.5 million levs as investors eyed repo facilities due to their high yield.
